sources.entry: Fusion - Lightweight RSS aggregator and reader. MIT Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: Fusion is a lightweight, self-hosted RSS/Atom feed reader written in Go, deployable as a single binary or Docker container.
summary.what_it_does: Fusion provides a web-based RSS reader with unread tracking, bookmarks, search, and Google Reader-style keyboard shortcuts. It parses RSS and Atom feeds, supports feed auto-discovery, and lets you organize feeds into groups. It offers Fever API compatibility so third-party mobile and desktop clients can sync with it. The UI is responsive and includes PWA support, with built-in translations for English, Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese, and Swedish. The README states it has no AI features by design.
use_cases: read news and blogs in one place
sync feeds with Fever-compatible mobile apps
run a feed reader on a home server
keep up with feeds without AI summaries
share a feed reader behind SSO
how_to_run: Download the binary for your platform from Releases, then run: chmod +x fusion && FUSION_PASSWORD="fusion" ./fusion
Or use Docker Compose with image ghcr.io/0x2e/fusion:latest, port 127.0.0.1:8080:8080, and FUSION_PASSWORD set
Build from source: see Contributing (uses ./scripts.sh build)
notable: Fever API compatibility for Reeder, Unread, FeedMe and other clients
Optional OIDC/SSO login instead of password-only auth
caveats: Contributions are limited to issues; the README asks users not to open pull requests
Running without a password is only meant for local trusted environments
